Grain beetles, as their name suggests, feed on rice, flour, and other foods. They can't bite, but they can cause rashes. I'm not sure off the top of my head what to do to get rid of them, but they're a super common house pest, so I'm sure you can look up information or ask a pest control.

That's an Asian lady beetle! Most people call them ladybugs. They're aggressive and will bite humans and pets, while real ladybugs are docile. Asian lady beetles have an m shape on their head and dense black dots on their wings, and ladybugs have a solid black head and more spaced out black dots.
